name: Ability Check
preview: A D20 Test made with an ability, sometimes using an associated skill, to overcome a challenge.

text.heading: Ability Check
text.body: An Ability Check is a D20 Test that represents using one of the six abilities, sometimes together with a specific skill, to overcome a challenge.

name: Concentration
preview: Some spells and effects require Concentration to stay active and end if Concentration is broken.

text.heading: Maintaining Concentration
text.body: Some spells and other effects require Concentration to remain active. You may end your Concentration voluntarily at any time without using an action.

text.heading: Another Concentration Effect
text.body: Starting another spell or effect that requires Concentration immediately ends the Concentration you were already maintaining.

text.heading: Taking Damage
text.body: When you take damage while concentrating, make a Constitution saving throw. The DC is 10 or half the damage taken, rounded down, whichever is higher. The DC cannot exceed 30.

text.heading: Incapacitated or Dead
text.body: Your Concentration ends if you gain the Incapacitated condition or die.

name: Cover
preview: Cover protects a target behind an obstacle, with stronger benefits for greater degrees of cover.

text.heading: Half Cover
text.body: A target with Half Cover gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class and Dexterity saving throws.

text.heading: Three-Quarters Cover
text.body: A target with Three-Quarters Cover gains a +5 bonus to Armor Class and Dexterity saving throws.

text.heading: Total Cover
text.body: A target with Total Cover cannot be targeted directly.

name: Grappled
preview: Your Speed becomes 0, some attacks are hindered, and the grappler can move you.

text.heading: Speed 0
text.body: Your Speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased while you are Grappled.

text.heading: Attacks Affected
text.body: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than the creature grappling you.

text.heading: Movable
text.body: The grappler can drag or carry you while moving. Each foot it moves normally costs 1 additional foot unless you are Tiny or at least two sizes smaller than the grappler.

name: Grappling
preview: Rules for starting, maintaining, and ending a grapple.

text.heading: Starting a Grapple
text.body: Characters usually grapple through an Unarmed Strike, while some creatures have special attacks that grapple. A successful grapple gives the target the Grappled condition.

text.heading: One Grapple per Hand
text.body: You normally need a free hand to grapple. A hand, tentacle, maw, or other body part used to hold one creature cannot grapple another creature or be used to target another creature unless that grapple ends.

text.heading: Ending a Grapple
text.body: A Grappled creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple's escape DC. Success ends the condition on that creature.

text.heading: Other Ways It Ends
text.body: The grapple also ends if the grappler becomes Incapacitated or the target moves beyond the grapple's range. The grappler may also release the target at any time without using an action.

name: Hide
preview: Make a Stealth check from suitable concealment to become hidden until something reveals you.

text.heading: Requirements
text.body: To Hide, make a DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) check while Heavily Obscured or behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover. You must also be outside every enemy's line of sight.

text.heading: Successful Check
text.body: On a success, you have the Invisible condition while you remain hidden. Record the total of your Stealth check; that number becomes the DC for a creature trying to find you with Wisdom (Perception).

text.heading: Revealing Yourself
text.body: You immediately stop being hidden if you make a sound louder than a whisper, an enemy finds you, you make an attack roll, or you cast a spell that has a Verbal component.

name: Opportunity Attacks
preview: A Reaction that can punish a creature you can see for leaving your reach in certain ways.

text.heading: Trigger
text.body: You can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature you can see leaves your reach by using its action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or one of its speeds.

text.heading: The Attack
text.body: Use your Reaction to make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the triggering creature.

text.heading: Timing
text.body: The attack happens immediately before the creature leaves your reach.

name: Prone
preview: While Prone, your movement is restricted and attack rolls are affected by distance.

text.heading: Restricted Movement
text.body: While Prone, you can crawl or spend movement equal to half your Speed, rounded down, to stand and end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you cannot stand this way.

text.heading: Your Attacks
text.body: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls while Prone.

text.heading: Attacks Against You
text.body: An attack roll against you has Advantage when the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, the attack roll has Disadvantage.

name: Reaction
preview: A special response to a defined trigger, normally usable once before the start of your next turn.

text.heading: Triggered Response
text.body: A Reaction is a special action taken in response to a trigger described by the rule that grants the Reaction.

text.heading: When You Can React
text.body: You can take a Reaction during another creature's turn. You may also take one during your own turn even if you also use an action, a Bonus Action, or both.

text.heading: One at a Time
text.body: After you take a Reaction, you cannot take another until the start of your next turn.

text.heading: Common Reaction
text.body: Opportunity Attacks are a Reaction available to all creatures.

name: Unarmed Strike
preview: Use your body in melee to deal damage, grapple a target, or shove it.

text.heading: Unarmed Strike
text.body: An Unarmed Strike is a melee attack using your body against a target within 5 feet. When you make one, choose Damage, Grapple, or Shove.

text.heading: Damage
text.body: Make an attack roll using your Strength modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. On a hit, the target takes Bludgeoning damage equal to 1 plus your Strength modifier.

text.heading: Grapple
text.body: The target chooses a Strength or Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Grappled. The save and escape DC equals 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. The target can be no more than one size larger than you, and you need a free hand.

text.heading: Shove
text.body: The target chooses a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. On a failure, you either push it 5 feet away or give it the Prone condition. The target can be no more than one size larger than you.
